title: What Does a CDRE Do
description:
Have you ever worked with an attorney outside of family law who struggled to navigate the complexities of a divorce case? The same applies to real estate. Working with a realtor who doesn’t specialize in divorce real estate can feel like fighting with a fish out of water.

I’m Gloria Miller, Associate Broker with Real Broker and your local Certified Divorce Real Estate Expert. With extensive training through the Illumni Institute, I understand the unique challenges of property division, restraining orders, and contentious negotiations. Let me handle all the real estate-related details so you can focus on the legal matters.

If you’re an attorney looking for an expert to represent your clients in real estate transactions or need assistance with home evaluations, deeds, or escrow, reach out to me today!
